svg.title: Ra.One Motion Gaming System Flowchart
svg.desc: End-to-end flowchart showing sensor data flow from ESP32 through movement detection, firmware processing, game interface, and iterative refinement loop for the Ra.One inspired motion gaming system.

g.text: Read sensors, filter noise, format & transmit data
Punch / Kick / Block / Jump / Special move
Interpret ESP32 data → in-game character actions
User feedback, adjust thresholds, fix latency
